tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page canvas everywhere. Never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Order mode only: nota, inputs, choice cards, secondary buttons sitting on paper.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Order-zone background (estimator panel), the DP line, photo placeholders. ink on kraft 13.3:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, hairlines, control borders, focus rings. 15.6:1 on paper. Text on orange fills is always ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: minimums, packaging, captions, meta. 5.7:1 on paper, 6.2:1 on card.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative row dividers inside lists only. 1.3:1 on paper: never for control borders.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand fill. One primary action per screen, the selected state, sleeve bands. Ink text on it (6.1:1). Never as text; white on it fails (2.8:1).

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: prices in lists, links. 4.6:1 on paper; white on it 5.0:1.

tokens.name: orange-ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for orange-ink links.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: One editorial band per page at most (clients, certificates, wedding hero) and the footer. paper text on it 13.2:1; orange on it 5.2:1.

tokens.name: pandan
tokens.usage: Halal badge, confirmations. 5.9:1 on paper; white on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: chili
tokens.usage: Errors and the under-minimum surcharge line. 6.1:1 on paper. Always with a text label, never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Desktop hero only. Scales with clamp(52px, 6.4vw, 96px).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section headings on desktop, under a double rule.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings on mobile; panel titles on desktop.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Meja saji lengkap, gubukan dan pramusaji.
styles.usage: Intro under a hero heading. Minimum 18px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo captions, in ink-muted. The only display style allowed under 24px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Harga sudah termasuk antar se-Kota Bogor.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Minimums, packaging, helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: List prices in orange-ink with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: nota-total
styles.usage: Totals in the nota and the sticky order bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between label and input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding; grid gutter; mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns and between list columns on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin and section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large section breaks on desktop.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max content width including 32px side padding (12-column grid, 24px gutter).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable control.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Read mode: photos, editorial panels, navy band.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, the DP line, small order-mode boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Order-mode cards: event tiles, estimator panel, nota bottom corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, stepper buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary button only: a pressable bottom edge. No other shadows in the system.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Control borders, panels, list tops. 15.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: rule-double
tokens.usage: Read mode: the line above every section heading.

tokens.name: rule-leader
tokens.usage: Dotted leader between package name and price.

tokens.name: rule-tear
tokens.usage: Divider above the total inside the nota.
